summary: Iter14: Joki/operator model regression. Verified public register UI removed (/register redirects to landing, Login page has no signup link), Admin can create operator (default plan elite / role user, password min 8), new operator logs in and reaches dashboard, account label create+rename via window.prompt works and persists, sidebar has NO nav-pricing, operator isolation confirmed (two operators see disjoint Telegram account lists, cross-user PATCH => 404), regression on admin/elite login + logout + delete-user. Backend pytest 11/11 passed. Playwright end-to-end flows all passed.

integration_issues.issue: Sidebar account switcher shows 4 duplicate 'Akun 1 · —' rows for a brand-new operator. Root cause: race in backend deps.ensure_default_account — several concurrent requests during initial dashboard mount (list_accounts + get_account_key from status/config/notifications) each see 0 accounts and each insert a default. Not new to iter14 but user-visible for operators created via admin. Suggest: change to atomic upsert with a unique compound index on (user_id, is_default) or use find_one_and_update with $setOnInsert.

action_items: Fix race in backend/deps.py::ensure_default_account so newly-provisioned operators get exactly ONE default 'Akun 1' (atomic upsert on {user_id} with $setOnInsert, or unique index).
critical_code_review_comments: deps.ensure_default_account: find_one -> insert_one is not atomic; concurrent requests during first login create duplicate 'Akun 1' rows for fresh users. Use find_one_and_update({user_id, is_default:true}, {$setOnInsert:{...}}, upsert=True) plus a unique partial index.
admin_routes.reset_password enforces min_length=6 while auth_routes/register (RegisterInput) and admin_routes.create_user enforce min_length=8. Password policy is inconsistent; align to 8 everywhere.

Admin.jsx client-side validation says 'Password minimal 6 karakter' at line 59 while the create form correctly checks 8; the reset-password prompt is capped at 6 which does not match register's 8. Consistency issue.

Login.jsx page still has `import { Link ... }` used only for the logo-back-to-home; fine, but note the `data-testid=login-forgot-hint` text mentions 'Lupa password? Minta admin mereset' which is good UX given self-register is disabled.
